destinations.why_go: Whistling Straits hosted the 2021 Ryder Cup and multiple PGA Championships. Four Pete Dye courses across two locations, all accessible through the American Club resort. The Midwest's answer to Bandon.

top_courses.name: Whistling Straits (Straits Course)
top_courses.must_know: Host of 2021 Ryder Cup and 3 PGA Championships. Links-style on Lake Michigan cliffs. Walking with caddie only. Budget $175+ for caddie+tip. Over 1,000 bunkers.

top_courses.name: Whistling Straits (Irish Course)
top_courses.must_know: Inland links style. More playable than Straits but still demanding. Walking with caddie available. Great value compared to Straits.

top_courses.name: Blackwolf Run (River Course)
top_courses.must_know: Pete Dye masterpiece through the Sheboygan River valley. Hosted 2012 US Women's Open. Many consider it the best course on property.

top_courses.name: Blackwolf Run (Meadow Valleys)
top_courses.must_know: More open than River Course. Good warm-up for the bigger courses. Still a serious Pete Dye test.

hidden_gems.name: The Bull at Pinehurst Farms
hidden_gems.must_know: Jack Nicklaus design 30 min from Kohler. Excellent alternative at half the price.

hidden_gems.name: The Bog
hidden_gems.must_know: Arnold Palmer design near Milwaukee. Links-style with great conditioning.

lodging_options.name: The American Club
lodging_options.note: Five-diamond resort. The only Forbes Five-Star resort hotel in the Midwest. Spa, restaurants, historic.

lodging_options.name: The Inn on Woodlake
lodging_options.note: More casual sibling of American Club. Access to all resort amenities. Better value.

lodging_options.name: Blue Harbor Resort (Sheboygan)
lodging_options.note: Waterpark resort on Lake Michigan. Fun for a different vibe. 10 min to Blackwolf Run.

dining.name: The Immigrant Restaurant (American Club)
dining.must_know: Fine dining with different ethnic-themed rooms. Jacket suggested. Top-tier.

dining.name: River Wildlife
dining.must_know: Private wilderness lodge accessible through resort. Log cabin dining. Must book ahead.

dining.name: Horse & Plow (American Club)
dining.must_know: Pub-style food and Wisconsin craft beer. Casual post-round spot.

non_golf_activities: Sport clay shooting at River Wildlife ($75)
insider_tips: The Straits is the bucket list course but Blackwolf Run River might actually be the better course. Play both.
Caddie fees at Straits: $75/person + tip (15-20%). Budget $175 total per player with caddie.
Book a 36-hole day: Straits in the morning, Irish in the afternoon for best value.
Summer in Wisconsin is gorgeous — 75-80°F, long days, green everything. Best time is July-August.
Stay at Inn on Woodlake instead of American Club — same course access, $100+/night cheaper.

activities: Arrive MKE, drive to Kohler (75 min)
Morning round at Whistling Straits ($400 + caddie)
Morning round at Blackwolf Run River ($300)
Breakfast at American Club, depart MKE

destinations.avoid_reason: 110°F+ desert heat. Unplayable afternoons. Even mornings are brutal.
destinations.why_go: Scottsdale's quieter, cheaper, more authentic cousin. Same desert golf, fewer crowds, lower prices. Plus Saguaro National Park and better Mexican food. For groups that want the Arizona golf experience without the Scottsdale scene.

top_courses.name: Ventana Canyon (Mountain Course)
top_courses.must_know: Tom Fazio design with the famous 'Hole in the Wall' par-3 — 107 yards to a green surrounded by canyon walls. Stunning Catalina Mountain backdrop.

top_courses.name: Arizona National Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Robert Trent Jones Jr. design. Tucson Mountains backdrop. Well-conditioned for the price.

top_courses.name: Sewailo Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Notah Begay III design at Casino Del Sol. Walking-friendly. Great value for Tucson.

top_courses.name: Omni Tucson National (Catalina Course)
top_courses.must_know: Former PGA Tour stop (Tucson Open). 36 holes. Catalina is the championship layout. Stay-and-play packages available.

hidden_gems.name: Quarry Pines Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Former copper mine turned golf course. Unique terrain. Incredible value.

hidden_gems.name: Tubac Golf Resort
hidden_gems.must_know: 45 min south toward Mexico border. Bing Crosby used to play here. Artist village nearby.

lodging_options.name: JW Marriott Starr Pass
lodging_options.note: 27 holes of Arnold Palmer golf on-site. Spa, pools, views. Excellent group resort.

lodging_options.name: Omni Tucson National Resort
lodging_options.note: On-site 36 holes. Former PGA Tour venue. Classic Tucson golf resort.

lodging_options.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Tucson
lodging_options.note: Good location, pool, free cookies. Solid budget base.

dining.name: El Charro Café
dining.must_know: Oldest Mexican restaurant in the US (1922). Carne seca is the signature. A Tucson institution.

dining.name: Prep & Pastry
dining.must_know: Best brunch in Tucson. Go before your round.

dining.name: Hacienda del Sol Guest Ranch
dining.must_know: Upscale Southwestern cuisine in a stunning hacienda. Date night level but groups welcome.

non_golf_activities: Brewery tour — Dragoon, Barrio, Pueblo Vida
insider_tips: Tucson is 30% cheaper than Scottsdale for comparable golf. The courses are just as scenic.
Ventana Canyon's Hole in the Wall is worth the green fee alone. Play it even if you only play one course.
Winter is peak season (Jan-Mar) but Tucson's peak is still cheaper than Scottsdale's shoulder season.
The Sonoran Desert Museum is genuinely one of the best attractions in Arizona. Not just a museum — it's a zoo, aquarium, and botanical garden in the desert.
Mexican food in Tucson is the best in the US. It's closer to the border and the cuisine shows it.

activities: Arrive TUS, check into JW Marriott Starr Pass
Morning round at Ventana Canyon Mountain ($160)

destinations.avoid_reason: Mountain winter. Snow, closures, cold.
destinations.why_go: Mountain golf with volcano views, 300 days of sunshine, and arguably the best craft beer scene per capita in America. Bend is the outdoor enthusiast's golf trip — play 18, then kayak, hike, or hit a brewery.

top_courses.name: Pronghorn (Nicklaus Course)
top_courses.must_know: Jack Nicklaus design through high desert with Cascade Mountain views. Hosted Web.com Tour. Best course in central Oregon.

top_courses.name: Tetherow Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: David McLay Kidd design (same as Bandon Dunes). Links-style at elevation. Wide fairways but tricky greens. Walking encouraged.

top_courses.name: Crosswater at Sunriver Resort
top_courses.must_know: Bob Cupp design through the Deschutes River. The Meadows is a great second course at Sunriver. Stay-and-play packages available.

top_courses.name: Brasada Canyons Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Peter Jacobsen design in the canyon rim country. Dramatic elevation changes. 20 min north of Bend.

hidden_gems.name: The Meadows at Sunriver
hidden_gems.must_know: More accessible than Crosswater. Great views, well-maintained. Good warm-up round.

hidden_gems.name: Juniper Golf Course
hidden_gems.must_know: Redmond muni. Best value in the area. Surprising quality for the price.

lodging_options.name: Sunriver Resort
lodging_options.note: Full resort with multiple courses, pools, bike rentals. Cabin and lodge options.

lodging_options.name: Tetherow Lodge
lodging_options.note: Boutique lodge on-site at Tetherow. Modern, upscale. Walking distance to course.

lodging_options.name: Bend VRBO/Airbnb houses
lodging_options.note: Houses near downtown. Walk to breweries. Hot tubs standard.

dining.name: Deschutes Brewery & Public House
dining.must_know: The OG Bend brewery. Fresh Squeezed IPA on tap. Pub food is solid. Must-visit.

dining.name: Bos Taurus
dining.must_know: Best steakhouse in Bend. Ranch-to-table beef. Reservations recommended.

dining.name: Crux Fermentation Project
dining.must_know: Open-air brewery with mountain views. Food carts. Perfect post-round spot.

non_golf_activities: Mountain biking Phil's Trail ($free, bike rental $50)
Smith Rock State Park climbing/hiking ($5 parking)
insider_tips: The Bend Ale Trail has 30+ breweries. Get a passport and collect stamps. It's basically a pub crawl with trophies.
Tetherow plays harder than it looks — the greens are massive with severe contours. Club selection is everything.
Summer days are long (sunset at 9pm in July). Play 36 easily with time for the river or a brewery after.
Float the Deschutes River through town — put in at Riverbend Park, float 2 hours, get out, walk to a brewery.
Bend is at 3,600 feet elevation. The ball flies 5-10% farther. Club down.

destinations.avoid_reason: Ski season. Courses closed under snow.
destinations.why_go: Mountain golf at 6,500+ feet with Wasatch Range views. Cool summer temps when the rest of the country melts. World-class dining from ski season carries over. Ball flies forever at altitude.

top_courses.name: Canyons Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: At Park City Mountain Resort. Mountain views on every hole. Dramatic elevation changes.

top_courses.name: Soldier Hollow (Gold Course)
top_courses.must_know: 36 holes on the 2002 Olympic venue. Heber Valley setting with mountain views. Great value.

top_courses.name: Wasatch Mountain State Park
top_courses.must_know: State park course. 36 holes. Best budget option with legitimate mountain scenery.

top_courses.name: Jeremy Ranch Golf & Country Club
top_courses.must_know: Arnold Palmer design. Semi-private with public play. Mountain setting along East Canyon Creek.

hidden_gems.name: The Ranches Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Eagle Mountain area. Stunning views, crazy cheap.

hidden_gems.name: Mountain Dell (Canyon Course)
hidden_gems.must_know: SLC muni in Parley's Canyon. Beautiful drive, great value.

lodging_options.name: Montage Deer Valley
lodging_options.note: Ultra-luxury. Summer rates 40-50% off winter.

lodging_options.name: Marriott Summit Watch
lodging_options.note: On Main Street. Walking distance to bars.

lodging_options.name: Park City VRBO condos
lodging_options.note: Ski condos cheap in summer. Hot tubs, mountain views.

dining.name: Handle
dining.must_know: Best restaurant on Main Street. Small plates, craft cocktails.

dining.name: Butcher's Chop House
dining.must_know: Classic steakhouse. Dry-aged prime. Group dinner spot.

dining.name: No Name Saloon
dining.must_know: Iconic dive bar. Buffalo burgers and cold beer. Must-visit.

non_golf_activities: Mountain biking Park City Mountain ($25 lift + $50 rental)
insider_tips: Summer is Park City's secret. 75F, no crowds, prices drop 40-50%.
Ball flies 10-15% farther at 6,500 feet. Club down.
Soldier Hollow is best value — two courses on the Olympic venue under $85.
No Name Saloon is the locals' bar. Buffalo burger and a PBR.
Provo River fly fishing is world-class, 20 min away.

activities: Arrive SLC, drive to Park City (40 min)

destinations.avoid_reason: Cold, snow, courses closed.
destinations.why_go: Home of the famous floating green — the only moveable par-3 in golf. The resort course is world-class, the lake is stunning, and Circling Raven casino course is a sleeper top-100 contender.

top_courses.name: Coeur d'Alene Resort Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: Famous floating green on #14 — par-3 to island green on Lake CdA. Boat shuttle to green. Forecaddie included. Immaculate.

top_courses.name: Circling Raven Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Gene Bates design on tribal land. Top-100 public caliber. 620 acres, no houses. Pure golf.

top_courses.name: The Idaho Club
top_courses.must_know: Jack Nicklaus design in Sandpoint (45 min north). Lake Pend Oreille. Worth the drive.

hidden_gems.name: Avondale Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Public course in Hayden. Solid value warm-up round.

hidden_gems.name: StoneRidge Golf Course
hidden_gems.must_know: Blanchard. Selkirk Mountain setting. Hidden gem.

lodging_options.name: The Coeur d'Alene Resort
lodging_options.note: Lakefront. Golf packages include course. Spa, pools, marina.

lodging_options.name: Coeur d'Alene Casino Resort
lodging_options.note: On-site at Circling Raven. Great value.

lodging_options.name: Lake CdA cabins
lodging_options.note: Waterfront cabins. Boat access, BBQ, views.

dining.name: Beverly's at the Resort
dining.must_know: 7th floor lake views. Best in CdA.

dining.name: The Cellar
dining.must_know: Underground steakhouse downtown. Great wine list.

dining.name: Daft Badger Brewing
dining.must_know: Best brewery in CdA. Good pub food.

insider_tips: Floating green moves daily — 100 to 175 yards. Genuinely surreal.
Circling Raven is better pure golf. CdA Resort is better overall experience.
Book resort 2-3 months out for July/August.
CdA Casino stay-and-play at Circling Raven: $150-200 for room + round.

destinations.avoid_reason: Florida summer heat and storms.
destinations.why_go: Barrier island with two major resorts and championship golf. Less crowded and more refined than most Florida destinations. Pete Dye's Oak Marsh and Tom Fazio's redesigned Ritz course are both top-tier.

top_courses.name: Amelia Island Oak Marsh
top_courses.must_know: Pete Dye design at Omni resort. Marsh and ocean views. Former PGA Tour venue.

top_courses.name: Omni Ocean Links
top_courses.must_know: Ocean breezes and dune views. More playable than Oak Marsh.

top_courses.name: Ritz-Carlton Amelia Island
top_courses.must_know: Redesigned by Tom Fazio. Best conditioning on the island.

top_courses.name: Golf Club of Amelia Island
top_courses.must_know: Semi-private. Good value alternative.

hidden_gems.name: Fernandina Beach Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Municipal course with character. Walking-friendly.

lodging_options.name: Omni Amelia Island Resort
lodging_options.note: Oceanfront. Two courses on-site. Pools, spa, beach.

lodging_options.name: The Ritz-Carlton Amelia Island
lodging_options.note: Full luxury. Corporate retreat level.

lodging_options.name: Amelia Island Plantation rentals
lodging_options.note: Condos and villas within the plantation.

dining.name: Joe's 2nd Street Bistro
dining.must_know: Downtown Fernandina. Best local restaurant.

dining.name: Timoti's Seafood Shak
dining.must_know: Casual fresh seafood. Fish tacos and cold beer.

dining.name: The Ritz Salt
dining.must_know: Oceanfront fine dining.

insider_tips: Omni resort packages bundle lodging + golf and save significantly.
Fernandina Beach downtown has better restaurants than resort dining.
Spring and fall have best value. Island is only 13 miles — everything close.

activities: Arrive JAX, drive to Amelia (35 min)

destinations.avoid_reason: Summer heat/humidity and peak tourist season.
destinations.why_go: The quieter, more sophisticated side of the Grand Strand. Caledonia and True Blue are top-100 caliber — better courses than Myrtle proper. Less traffic, better seafood.

top_courses.name: Caledonia Golf & Fish Club
top_courses.must_know: Mike Strantz masterpiece. Live oaks, marsh, rice paddies. #1 course in the Myrtle Beach area. Walking encouraged.

top_courses.name: True Blue Golf Plantation
top_courses.must_know: Also Mike Strantz. Bigger, bolder than Caledonia. Massive greens and waste bunkers. Sister course — play both.

top_courses.name: Tradition Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Good value option. Well-maintained and group-friendly.

top_courses.name: Litchfield Country Club
top_courses.must_know: Classic Lowcountry feel with live oaks and marsh.

hidden_gems.name: Willbrook Plantation
hidden_gems.must_know: Former rice plantation. Alligator sightings guaranteed.

hidden_gems.name: Heritage Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Waccamaw River setting. Quiet, scenic, well-kept.

lodging_options.name: Litchfield Beach & Golf Resort
lodging_options.note: Oceanfront condos. Golf packages. Best group value.

lodging_options.name: Pawleys Island beach houses
lodging_options.note: Classic beach cottages.

lodging_options.name: Pawleys Plantation Golf & CC
lodging_options.note: Nicklaus course on-site. Good stay-and-play.

dining.name: Frank's Restaurant
dining.must_know: Best restaurant in Pawleys. Italian-Southern. Reservations required.

dining.name: Rustic Table
dining.must_know: Farm-to-table in Pawleys.

dining.name: Pawleys Raw Bar
dining.must_know: Fresh oysters and shrimp. Casual waterfront.

insider_tips: Play Caledonia and True Blue back-to-back. They're across the street from each other.
Caledonia's 18th — walking through live oaks to the antebellum clubhouse — is one of golf's great finishes.
Book Caledonia early. It sells out 30+ days in advance in spring/fall.
Stay in Pawleys, not Myrtle Beach. 30 min difference in drive but worlds apart in vibe.

activities: Arrive MYR, drive to Pawleys (40 min)

destinations.avoid_reason: Can hit 100F. Also monsoon season with afternoon storms.
destinations.why_go: Red rock desert golf that's unlike anything else in America. Sedona Golf Resort's back nine plays through crimson canyon walls. Combine with Scottsdale courses for a multi-stop Arizona trip.

top_courses.name: Sedona Golf Resort
top_courses.must_know: The signature hole #10 has Cathedral Rock and Courthouse Butte as backdrop — most photographed hole in Arizona. Back nine is through red rock canyons.

top_courses.name: Seven Canyons Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Tom Weiskopf design. Private but limited public play available. Red rock vistas on every hole. Call pro shop for availability.

top_courses.name: Oakcreek Country Club
top_courses.must_know: Robert Trent Jones Sr. design in the Village of Oak Creek. Red rock views at a more accessible price point.

hidden_gems.name: Agave Highlands Golf Course (Prescott)
hidden_gems.must_know: 45 min from Sedona. Newer course with dramatic views. Great value.

hidden_gems.name: Antelope Hills (Prescott)
hidden_gems.must_know: Two municipal courses in Prescott. 45 min drive. Mountain golf at budget prices.

lodging_options.name: Enchantment Resort
lodging_options.note: In Boynton Canyon. Spa, hiking, stunning red rock setting. Bucket list lodging.

lodging_options.name: Hilton Sedona at Bell Rock
lodging_options.note: Adjacent to Sedona Golf Resort. Pool, views. Good mid-range.

lodging_options.name: Sedona/VOC VRBO
lodging_options.note: Red rock view homes. Hot tubs. Split among group.

dining.name: Mariposa Latin Inspired Grill
dining.must_know: Lisa Dahl's masterpiece. Panoramic red rock views. Best restaurant in Sedona.

dining.name: Elote Cafe
dining.must_know: No-reservation Mexican-inspired. Line up early — worth every minute.

dining.name: Oak Creek Brewery
dining.must_know: Local craft beer and pub food. Casual post-round spot.

insider_tips: Sedona Golf Resort #10 tee box at golden hour is the best photo op in Arizona golf.
Combine with Scottsdale: play Sedona courses days 1-2, drive to Scottsdale day 3-4.
The Verde Valley wine region is 20 min away — excellent day trip between rounds.
Book spring (Mar-Apr) for wildflowers in the red rocks. Spectacular.
Sedona is at 4,300 feet — ball flies 5-8% farther. Adjust clubs.

activities: Arrive PHX, drive to Sedona (2 hrs)
Breakfast, depart PHX or drive to Scottsdale

destinations.airport_to_courses_drive: 90 min from SDF, 2 hrs from IND
destinations.avoid_reason: Indiana winter. Courses close or in poor shape.
destinations.why_go: Two Pete Dye courses in the rolling hills of southern Indiana. French Lick Resort is a historic grand hotel with casino. Dye Course hosted the Senior PGA Championship. Best golf value in the Midwest after RTJ Trail.

top_courses.name: Pete Dye Course at French Lick
top_courses.must_know: Hilltop course with 360-degree views of Hoosier National Forest. Hosted Senior PGA Championship. Walking encouraged. One of Dye's best.

top_courses.name: Donald Ross Course at French Lick
top_courses.must_know: Restored 1917 Donald Ross design. Classic golden-age architecture. More playable than the Dye Course. Both courses are on-site at the resort.

top_courses.name: Sultan's Run Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Tim Liddy design 5 min from the resort. Hilly terrain through hardwood forest. Great value addition to a French Lick trip.

hidden_gems.name: Fuzzy Zoeller's Covered Bridge
hidden_gems.must_know: Fuzzy Zoeller's home course. 15 min from French Lick. Fun, friendly, well-maintained.

lodging_options.name: French Lick Springs Hotel
lodging_options.note: Historic 1845 hotel. Casino, spa, pools. Golf packages available.

lodging_options.name: West Baden Springs Hotel
lodging_options.note: The 'Eighth Wonder of the World' — massive domed atrium. Luxury sister property.

lodging_options.name: Comfort Suites / local motels
lodging_options.note: Basic but functional. French Lick is small — everything is close.

dining.name: 1875: The Steakhouse (West Baden)
dining.must_know: Best steakhouse in southern Indiana. In the stunning West Baden hotel.

dining.name: Hagen's Club House Grill
dining.must_know: At the resort. Casual post-round dining with views.

dining.name: 33 Brick Street
dining.must_know: Downtown French Lick. Craft cocktails and pub food.

non_golf_activities: West Baden Springs Hotel dome tour (free)
insider_tips: The Pete Dye Course is brutally hard from the tips. Play the whites/blues and enjoy it.
West Baden Springs Hotel atrium is jaw-dropping — even if you stay at French Lick Springs, walk over to see it.
Book a 2-course package (Dye + Ross) for 15-20% savings.
French Lick is remote — that's the charm. Nothing to do but golf, eat, and gamble.
Fall foliage (Oct) in Hoosier National Forest makes the Dye Course otherworldly.

activities: Arrive, check into French Lick Springs

destinations.airport_to_courses_drive: 15 min from ACY, 75 min from PHL
destinations.avoid_reason: Cold, wind, many courses close.
destinations.why_go: Casino nightlife + unexpectedly good golf. AC area has several top-tier public courses including some of the best links-style in the Northeast. Play 18, hit the casino, repeat. Perfect party golf trip for the Northeast crowd.

top_courses.name: Ballamor Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Part of Atlantic City CC. Best conditioned course in the AC area. Fair test for all skill levels.

top_courses.name: Twisted Dune Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Links-style course built on Sand dunes. Feels like Scotland in New Jersey. Wind is always a factor.

top_courses.name: Shore Gate Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Ron Forse and Jim Nagle design. Good shape, fair price. Less crowded than Twisted Dune.

top_courses.name: Sand Barrens Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: 27 holes through Pine Barrens. Good group-friendly layout. Multiple nines keep it interesting.

hidden_gems.name: McCullough's Emerald Links
hidden_gems.must_know: Municipal in Egg Harbor Township. Surprisingly good for the price.

hidden_gems.name: Blue Heron Pines
hidden_gems.must_know: In Galloway. Well-maintained with pine barrens setting.

lodging_options.name: Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa
lodging_options.note: Best casino in AC. Pool, nightclubs, restaurants. Walking distance to boardwalk.

lodging_options.name: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino
lodging_options.note: Music-themed casino. Good pool scene. Group-friendly vibe.

lodging_options.name: Tropicana / Resorts Casino
lodging_options.note: Budget casino options. Still fun, just less flashy.

dining.name: Borgata's Old Homestead Steakhouse
dining.must_know: One of the best steakhouses on the East Coast. Serious meats.

dining.name: Dock's Oyster House
dining.must_know: Since 1897. Legendary AC seafood institution.

dining.name: Tony's Baltimore Grill
dining.must_know: 24-hour Italian-American diner. Post-casino 3am pizza. An AC tradition.

insider_tips: Twisted Dune is the must-play — genuine links golf near the shore. Wind makes it brutal but fun.
Borgata is the clear winner for casino/hotel quality. Worth the premium over boardwalk casinos.
Midweek casino rates drop 40-50%. Golf + gambling = Mon-Thu is the smart play.
AC is 60 min from Philly — fly into PHL for cheaper flights if needed.
Spring (May-Jun) and fall (Sep-Oct) have the best golf weather and lower hotel rates.

destinations.avoid_reason: New York winter. Cold, courses closed.
destinations.why_go: Wine country golf in upstate New York. Beautiful lake views, 100+ wineries, and surprising golf value. Perfect for the group that wants to mix rounds with wine tasting and relaxation. No pretense, just good times.

top_courses.name: The Club at Bristol Harbour
top_courses.must_know: Robert Trent Jones Sr. design on Canandaigua Lake. Stunning views. Lodge on-site for stay-and-play.

top_courses.name: Ravenwood Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Well-maintained public course near Victor. Good test without being punishing.

top_courses.name: Centennial Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: In Carmel (closer to NYC). Denis Griffiths design. Excellent conditioning for a semi-public course.

top_courses.name: Reservoir Creek Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: In Naples. Vineyard views. Basic but scenic. Great warm-up round.

hidden_gems.name: Salmon Creek Country Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Spencerport. Walking-friendly, well-groomed for the price.

hidden_gems.name: Mark Twain Golf Course (Elmira)
hidden_gems.must_know: State park course. Beautiful setting. 30 min drive but incredible value.

lodging_options.name: Bristol Harbour Resort
lodging_options.note: On Canandaigua Lake. On-site golf. Rooms and cabins.

lodging_options.name: The Inn at Glenora Wine Cellars
lodging_options.note: On Seneca Lake. Wine tasting on-site. Romantic but works for small groups.

lodging_options.name: Lake house VRBO rentals
lodging_options.note: Houses on Keuka, Seneca, or Canandaigua lakes. Best for groups.

dining.name: Belhurst Castle
dining.must_know: Lakefront castle restaurant on Seneca Lake. Special occasion level.

dining.name: FLX Table
dining.must_know: Chef's table experience in Geneva. 12 seats. Reservations months out.

dining.name: Simply Red Bistro
dining.must_know: Trumansburg. Farm-to-table with local wine pairings. Excellent.

non_golf_activities: Watkins Glen State Park gorge trail (free)
insider_tips: The Seneca Lake Wine Trail has 30+ tasting rooms in a 15-mile stretch. Hire a driver or van.
Bristol Harbour's 16th hole overlooking the lake is one of the prettiest in New York.
Late August/September: warm weather + grape harvest = wineries at their best.
Watkins Glen gorge trail is a must — 200-foot cliffs and 19 waterfalls in 2 miles. Free.
Group rental houses on the lakes are the move. Dock access, grills, fire pits.

activities: Arrive ROC, drive to lake house

destinations.avoid_reason: Peak season pricing. Great weather but prices double. Book far in advance if going.
destinations.why_go: The PGA Tour's Sentry Tournament of Champions venue. Ocean-to-mountain golf on one of the most beautiful islands on Earth. Kapalua Plantation Course is bucket list. Combine with Maui's beaches, whale watching, and Road to Hana.

top_courses.name: Kapalua Plantation Course
top_courses.must_know: Host of PGA Tour's Sentry Tournament of Champions. Dramatic elevation changes with ocean views on every hole. The 18th is one of the most iconic finishing holes in golf.

top_courses.name: Kapalua Bay Course
top_courses.must_know: More playable than Plantation. Ocean views, Molokai Island backdrop. Recently redesigned.

top_courses.name: Royal Ka'anapali Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: In Ka'anapali resort area. Ocean and mountain views. More accessible than Kapalua.

top_courses.name: Wailea Gold Course
top_courses.must_know: South side of Maui. Robert Trent Jones Jr. design. Three courses at Wailea — Gold is the championship test.

hidden_gems.name: Kahili Golf Course
hidden_gems.must_know: In the West Maui Mountains. Less famous, less crowded, still gorgeous. Good value by Maui standards.

hidden_gems.name: Maui Nui Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Near Wailea. Renovated former Elleair course. Best budget option in South Maui.

lodging_options.name: The Ritz-Carlton Kapalua
lodging_options.note: Steps from Plantation Course. Full luxury. Pool, spa, beach access.

lodging_options.name: Montage Kapalua Bay
lodging_options.note: Luxury residences with kitchens. Perfect for groups splitting a multi-bedroom suite.

lodging_options.name: Ka'anapali condos (VRBO)
lodging_options.note: Beachfront condos in Ka'anapali. Walking distance to courses and restaurants.

dining.name: Mama's Fish House
dining.must_know: Most famous restaurant in Maui. Oceanfront. Fish caught daily. Reservations months out.

dining.name: Merriman's Kapalua
dining.must_know: Farm-to-table with ocean views. Perfect post-round sunset dinner.

dining.name: Monkeypod Kitchen
dining.must_know: Peter Merriman's casual spot. Craft cocktails, pizza, good vibes.

insider_tips: Book Plantation Course tee times the moment they open (90 days out). It sells out fast.
Shoulder season (Apr-May, Sep-Oct) has the best value: still perfect weather, 30-40% off peak rates.
Plantation Course plays 2-3 clubs downhill on many holes. Trust the elevation.
Mama's Fish House: book 2-3 months ahead. Not kidding. Or try for a walk-in lunch.
Rent a car — Uber/Lyft are unreliable on Maui. You'll need wheels for courses and restaurants.

destinations.avoid_reason: Hurricane season. Heavy rains, some courses temporarily close.
destinations.why_go: All-inclusive resorts with golf included. Caribbean beaches, cenotes, ancient ruins, and nightlife. Your dollar goes 2-3x farther in Mexico. Jack Nicklaus designed El Camaleon hosts the PGA Tour.

top_courses.name: El Camaleon Golf Course (Mayakoba)
top_courses.must_know: Host of PGA Tour's World Wide Technology Championship. Greg Norman design through jungle, mangroves, and Caribbean coast. One hole plays along the beach.

top_courses.name: Playa Mujeres Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Greg Norman design north of Cancun. Ocean views and mangroves. Part of Dreams resort complex.

top_courses.name: Iberostar Playa Paraiso Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: P.B. Dye design in the jungle. Cenotes on the course. Part of Iberostar all-inclusive — guests get discounted rates.

top_courses.name: Puerto Cancun Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: Tom Weiskopf design right in Cancun hotel zone. Lagoon and mangrove scenery. Convenient if staying in Cancun.

hidden_gems.name: Riviera Cancun Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Jack Nicklaus design. Less crowded than El Camaleon. Good value.

hidden_gems.name: Hard Rock Golf Club Riviera Maya
hidden_gems.must_know: Robert von Hagge design. Connected to Hard Rock all-inclusive.

lodging_options.name: Mayakoba resorts (Fairmont/Rosewood/Banyan Tree)
lodging_options.note: Luxury all-inclusive with El Camaleon access. Pool, beach, spa, food/drinks included.

lodging_options.name: Iberostar Selection Paraiso
lodging_options.note: Great mid-range all-inclusive. On-site golf. Large group-friendly.

lodging_options.name: Cancun Hotel Zone all-inclusives
lodging_options.note: Dozens of options. Beach, pools, nightlife. Book golf separately.

dining.name: All-inclusive restaurants
dining.must_know: Most stays are all-inclusive so dining is covered. Quality varies by resort — Mayakoba resorts have the best food.

dining.name: La Fisheria (Playa del Carmen)
dining.must_know: Best seafood on 5th Avenue. Ceviche is incredible.

dining.name: Porfirio's (Cancun)
dining.must_know: Upscale Mexican cuisine. If you leave the resort for one dinner, make it this.

insider_tips: All-inclusive is the move for groups. Food, drinks, and often golf included. Do the math — it's almost always cheaper.
El Camaleon is the prestige course, but Iberostar gives 80% of the experience at half the price.
Playa del Carmen has better nightlife than Cancun hotel zone for younger groups. 5th Avenue is walkable.
Dollar goes far: caddie tips, drinks, dinners off-resort are all 40-60% cheaper than US equivalents.
Hurricane season is Aug-Oct. Insurance is worth it. Nov-Apr is perfect weather.

destinations.avoid_reason: Hurricane season. Heat and heavy rain.
destinations.why_go: Caribbean all-inclusive + world-class golf at unbeatable prices. Multiple Jack Nicklaus and P.B. Dye designs with ocean holes. Your dollar stretches far. Perfect bachelor party or buddy trip.

top_courses.name: Punta Espada Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Jack Nicklaus design at Cap Cana. 8 holes on the Caribbean. #1 course in the Caribbean and Latin America by Golf Digest. The Pebble Beach of the Caribbean.

top_courses.name: Corales Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: Tom Fazio design at Puntacana Resort. Host of PGA Tour's Corales Championship. Six holes along coral cliffs. The 'Devil's Elbow' finish is legendary.

top_courses.name: La Cana Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: P.B. Dye design at Puntacana Resort. 27 holes. More playable than Corales. Ocean views on several holes.

top_courses.name: Iberostar Bavaro Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: P.B. Dye design at Iberostar all-inclusive. Guests get discounted rates. Good value included in some packages.

hidden_gems.name: Catalonia Caribe Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Newer Alberto Sola design. Less famous, lower cost, still good.

lodging_options.name: Puntacana Resort & Club
lodging_options.note: Three courses on-site. Beach, spa, restaurants. The premier golf resort.

lodging_options.name: Iberostar Selection Bavaro
lodging_options.note: On-site golf. Large group-friendly. Great value all-inclusive.

lodging_options.name: Hard Rock Hotel Punta Cana
lodging_options.note: Party all-inclusive. Casino, nightclub, pool scene.

dining.name: All-inclusive dining
dining.must_know: All-inclusive covers most meals. Puntacana Resort has best restaurant variety.

dining.name: La Yola
dining.must_know: At Puntacana Marina. Fresh seafood, water views. Worth leaving the resort.

insider_tips: Punta Espada is the must-play. Budget for it even if you play cheaper courses the other days.
All-inclusive math: room + unlimited food/drinks + golf discounts = always better value than booking separately.
Caddie tips are cheap by US standards — $30-40 per bag is generous and appreciated.
Hard Rock is the bachelor party resort. Puntacana Resort is the golf-focused option.
Flights from East Coast are 3-4 hours direct. Easier than you think.

destinations.avoid_reason: Peak summer heat (90F+) and peak European tourist season. Crowded and expensive.
destinations.why_go: Europe's premier golf destination. 40+ courses along the sunny south coast of Portugal. Clifftop ocean holes, world-class resorts, incredible food and wine at European prices. Direct flights from East Coast hubs.

top_courses.name: Monte Rei North Course
top_courses.must_know: Jack Nicklaus design. #1 course in Portugal. Immaculate conditioning. Eastern Algarve near the Spanish border.

top_courses.name: Quinta do Lago South
top_courses.must_know: Three courses at Quinta do Lago. South is the championship test — hosted Portuguese Open multiple times. Pine forests and lagoon views.

top_courses.name: San Lorenzo Golf Course
top_courses.must_know: Adjacent to Quinta do Lago. Ria Formosa wetlands setting. One of Europe's most beautiful courses. Flamingos on the course.

top_courses.name: Vale do Lobo Royal
top_courses.must_know: The iconic clifftop par-3 16th over red cliffs to the sea. Most photographed hole in European golf.

hidden_gems.name: Amendoeira Faldo Course
hidden_gems.must_know: Nick Faldo design inland. Surprisingly good for the price. Less crowded.

hidden_gems.name: Silves Golf
hidden_gems.must_know: Inland course near historic Silves castle. Great budget option.

lodging_options.name: Conrad Algarve (Quinta do Lago)
lodging_options.note: Luxury resort. Walking distance to Quinta courses. Pool, spa, restaurants.

lodging_options.name: Pine Cliffs Resort
lodging_options.note: 9-hole clifftop course on-site. Near Albufeira. Full resort amenities.

lodging_options.name: Algarve villa rentals
lodging_options.note: Private villas with pools. Best for groups of 6+. Private chef available.

dining.name: Gusto by Heinz Beck
dining.must_know: Michelin-starred at Conrad. Mediterranean fine dining.

dining.name: A Ria (Faro)
dining.must_know: Fresh seafood on the Ria Formosa. Local institution. Grilled fish is incredible.

dining.name: Noélia & Jerónimo (Cabanas)
dining.must_know: Simple beachside grilled fish restaurant. One of the best meals you'll have anywhere.

non_golf_activities: Beach day at Praia da Marinha (free)
Lagos old town and cliff walks
Faro old town and Ria Formosa boat trip
insider_tips: Book a golf passport: multi-course packages save 20-30% vs. individual green fees.
Spring (Mar-May) and fall (Sep-Nov) are the sweet spots: warm, affordable, less crowded.
Vale do Lobo #16: take a photo before you hit. The cliff backdrop is unreal regardless of your score.
Portuguese wine is criminally underrated. €5-10 bottles rival $30-40 bottles from France/California.
Fly into Faro (FAO) — direct flights from London, other EU hubs. East Coast flights connect through Lisbon.
The food in the Algarve is some of the best value in Europe. Full seafood dinner for €15-25/person.

destinations.avoid_reason: Short days, cold, rain. Courses playable but conditions are rough.
destinations.why_go: The birthplace of links golf. Ballybunion, Lahinch, Tralee, and Waterville are all within driving distance in County Kerry and Clare. Pubs with live music, Guinness, and the most dramatic coastal golf on Earth.

top_courses.name: Ballybunion (Old Course)
top_courses.must_know: One of the greatest links courses ever built. Towering sand dunes, Atlantic views. Walking only. Tom Watson called it the best links course he's ever played.

top_courses.name: Lahinch Golf Club (Old Course)
top_courses.must_know: The 'St. Andrews of Ireland.' Overlooking Liscannor Bay. Iconic Goat Tower. The Dell hole (#5) is blind and unforgettable.

top_courses.name: Tralee Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Arnold Palmer's only European design. Dramatic ocean cliff holes. Back nine is some of the most spectacular golf anywhere. Very difficult in wind.

top_courses.name: Waterville Golf Links
top_courses.must_know: On the Ring of Kerry. Classic links in a remote, stunning setting. Payne Stewart statue at the 1st tee. Less crowded than Ballybunion.

hidden_gems.name: Dooks Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Old links course overlooking Dingle Bay. Charming, authentic, affordable.

hidden_gems.name: Ceann Sibéal (Dingle)
hidden_gems.must_know: Westernmost golf course in Europe. Dramatic cliffs. Star Wars was filmed nearby.

lodging_options.name: The Europe Hotel & Resort (Killarney)
lodging_options.note: Luxury lakeside hotel. Central base for all courses. Spa, restaurants.

lodging_options.name: Traditional B&Bs (various)
lodging_options.note: The Irish experience. Full Irish breakfast. Pub walking distance. Book individual rooms.

lodging_options.name: Dingle Skellig Hotel
lodging_options.note: In Dingle town. Pool, spa. Great base for Dingle Peninsula courses.

dining.name: Local pubs (every town)
dining.must_know: Irish pubs are the dining experience. Fresh seafood, lamb stew, Guinness. Live music most nights.

dining.name: The Chart House (Dingle)
dining.must_know: Best restaurant in Dingle. Seafood-focused. Reservations recommended.

dining.name: Lord Baker's (Dingle)
dining.must_know: Pub food and pints. Great craic (fun). Live trad music.

non_golf_activities: Ring of Kerry drive (full day, free)
insider_tips: Bring rain gear for every round. Seriously. It will rain. It will also be sunny. Often in the same hour.
Walking is the only option and the only way to play links golf. Get a pull trolley if you don't use a caddie.
Ballybunion books up 3 months out in summer. Don't delay.
Irish pubs are the real cultural experience. Skip fancy restaurants — eat in pubs.
Rent a car and embrace driving on the left. Roads are narrow but manageable. Buses don't reach the courses.
May and September offer the best combo of weather, daylight, and lower prices.

activities: Dooks Golf Club (€80) or rest day

destinations.avoid_reason: June Gloom — marine layer means fog until noon. Golf is fine but gray.
destinations.why_go: Municipal golf at a US Open venue overlooking the Pacific. Torrey Pines South is the best municipal course in America — hosted Tiger's famous 2008 US Open. La Jolla's restaurants and beaches complete the trip.

top_courses.name: Torrey Pines (South Course)
top_courses.must_know: Host of 2008 and 2021 US Opens and annual PGA Tour Farmers Insurance Open. Ocean cliff views. San Diego residents get discounted rates ($100). Non-residents pay $202-275. Book via lottery system 7 days in advance.

top_courses.name: Torrey Pines (North Course)
top_courses.must_know: More playable than South. Same ocean views. Recently renovated by Tom Weiskopf. Great warm-up if playing South the next day.

top_courses.name: Maderas Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Best private-quality course open to public in San Diego. 30 min north. Excellent conditioning year-round.

hidden_gems.name: Balboa Park Golf Course
hidden_gems.must_know: San Diego's beloved muni. Walking-friendly. Downtown views. Classic.

hidden_gems.name: Coronado Municipal Golf Course
hidden_gems.must_know: Oceanside muni on Coronado Island. Views of downtown and the bridge.

lodging_options.name: The Lodge at Torrey Pines
lodging_options.note: Adjacent to Torrey Pines. Craftsman luxury. Spa, A.R. Valentien restaurant.

lodging_options.name: La Jolla Shores Hotel
lodging_options.note: Beachfront. Walking distance to La Jolla village. 10 min to Torrey Pines.

lodging_options.name: Hilton La Jolla Torrey Pines
lodging_options.note: Overlooking Torrey Pines. Pool, restaurant. Good mid-range.

dining.name: A.R. Valentien (Lodge at Torrey Pines)
dining.must_know: Farm-to-table at the Lodge. Best restaurant in La Jolla.

dining.name: George's at the Cove
dining.must_know: Ocean-view rooftop. La Jolla institution. Get the Ocean Terrace for casual.

dining.name: Taco Stand
dining.must_know: Best fish tacos in La Jolla. Cash only. Line out the door. Worth it.

non_golf_activities: Beach day at La Jolla Shores (free)
Craft brewery tour — San Diego has 150+ ($15-30 tastings)
insider_tips: Book Torrey Pines through the online lottery system exactly 7 days in advance. Set an alarm.
If you can't get a South Course time, book North and add your name to the South standby list at the pro shop.
San Diego residents pay $100 for South Course. If anyone in your group lives there, book under their name.
The marine layer burns off by noon most days. Afternoon rounds often have better weather and views.
La Jolla has the best combo of golf + dining + beach in California. Better than Pebble Beach area for a group.

activities: Arrive SAN, check into La Jolla

destinations.airport_to_courses_drive: 15 min from MDT, 2 hrs from PHL
destinations.avoid_reason: Cold Pennsylvania winter. Some courses close.
destinations.why_go: The Sweetest Place on Earth has surprisingly excellent golf. Hershey Country Club courses have hosted PGA Tour events. Hotel Hershey is a grand resort with chocolate spa treatments. Perfect for father-son or family-friendly golf trips with non-golf entertainment.

top_courses.name: Hershey Country Club (East Course)
top_courses.must_know: George Fazio design. Former LPGA Championship venue. Resort guests get access. Best conditioning in the region.

top_courses.name: Hershey Country Club (West Course)
top_courses.must_know: Maurice McCarthy design. Classic layout through rolling Pennsylvania hills. More playable than East.

top_courses.name: Hershey Links
top_courses.must_know: 9-hole par-3 course and full 18-hole layout. Good warm-up or family-friendly option.

top_courses.name: Royal Oaks Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: 15 min from Hershey. Public course with a resort feel. Good budget option.

hidden_gems.name: Iron Valley Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: In Cornwall. P.B. Dye design. Dramatically underpriced for the quality.

hidden_gems.name: Blue Mountain Golf Course
hidden_gems.must_know: Mountain setting 20 min north. Views and value.

lodging_options.name: Hotel Hershey
lodging_options.note: Grand 1933 hotel. Chocolate spa, formal gardens, pool. Golf packages available.

lodging_options.name: Hershey Lodge
lodging_options.note: More casual than Hotel Hershey. Indoor water park, restaurants. Better for families.

lodging_options.name: Hampton Inn / local hotels
lodging_options.note: Standard chains near the park. Functional and affordable.

dining.name: The Circular (Hotel Hershey)
dining.must_know: Fine dining in the grand hotel. Sunday brunch is legendary.

dining.name: Hershey Grill
dining.must_know: At Hershey Lodge. Casual American fare. Good post-round spot.

dining.name: What-A-Burger
dining.must_know: Local chain since 1957. Not Whataburger — unique to Hershey. Milkshakes.

insider_tips: Hotel Hershey golf packages bundle 2 courses + lodging and save 15-20%.
The Chocolate Spa sounds gimmicky but it's actually excellent. Chocolate body wrap = serious relaxation.
Fall foliage (Oct) makes the East Course stunning. Book early for peak color.
Troegs Brewery is 10 min away and one of the best craft breweries in the Mid-Atlantic.
If anyone has kids, Hersheypark makes this the easiest 'golf trip with family' sell.

destinations.avoid_reason: Michigan winter. Courses closed.
destinations.why_go: Best craft beer city in America + excellent affordable golf. Lake Michigan dune courses, great public options, and you'll spend half what you would at most destination trips. The Midwest's best-kept golf secret.

top_courses.name: Arcadia Bluffs (Bluffs Course)
top_courses.must_know: Perched on 200-foot bluffs over Lake Michigan. Links-style with ocean-like views. Walking only. 90 min from GR but absolutely must-play. One of the best public courses in America.

top_courses.name: Arcadia Bluffs (South Course)
top_courses.must_know: Dana Fry & Jason Straka design. Inland links through dunes and wetlands. Walking only. Complements the Bluffs Course beautifully.

top_courses.name: Thousand Oaks Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Best value in the Grand Rapids area. Well-maintained. Good test without being punishing.

top_courses.name: Tullymore Golf Resort
top_courses.must_know: Jim Engh design. 45 min from GR. 36 holes (Tullymore + St. Ives). Dramatic elevation changes through northern Michigan forest. Stay-and-play available.

hidden_gems.name: The Meadows at GVSU
hidden_gems.must_know: University course. Michael Hurdzan design. Absurd value for the quality.

hidden_gems.name: Ravines Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Arnold Palmer design in Saugatuck. Deep ravines, elevation, character.

lodging_options.name: Amway Grand Plaza Hotel
lodging_options.note: Downtown GR. Walking distance to breweries. Historic hotel.

lodging_options.name: Tullymore Golf Resort
lodging_options.note: On-site at Tullymore. Cottages and lodge rooms. 36 holes of golf.

lodging_options.name: Hampton Inn / Courtyard GR
lodging_options.note: Standard chains. Central location. Clean and reliable.

dining.name: Founders Brewing Co.
dining.must_know: One of the most famous craft breweries in America. Taproom + restaurant. KBS and All Day IPA.

dining.name: Brewery Vivant
dining.must_know: Belgian-style brewery in a converted chapel. Outstanding food and beer.

dining.name: San Chez Bistro
dining.must_know: Best restaurant in downtown GR. Tapas-style. Great for groups.

non_golf_activities: Grand Rapids Beer City Ale Trail (free passport)
Lake Michigan beach day at Holland/Saugatuck
insider_tips: Arcadia Bluffs is 90 min drive but non-negotiable. Some call it a 'poor man's Bandon Dunes.' They're wrong — it's its own masterpiece.
Grand Rapids has 80+ breweries. The Ale Trail passport rewards you for visiting them. Bring a designated driver.
July and August are Michigan summer — perfect weather, long days, Lake Michigan is warm enough to swim.
Book Arcadia early. Weekends sell out fast in summer.
Make it a road trip: GR breweries + Tullymore + Arcadia Bluffs = the ultimate Midwest golf trip.

activities: Arrive GRR, check into downtown GR
Brunch at San Chez, depart GRR

destinations.nearest_airport: LIT (Little Rock) or XNA (Northwest Arkansas Regional)
destinations.airport_to_courses_drive: 60 min from LIT to Hot Springs
destinations.avoid_reason: Arkansas summer heat and humidity. 95F+.
destinations.why_go: Possibly the best golf value in America outside the RTJ Trail. Hot Springs Village has 9(!) courses, all beautiful Ozark mountain layouts at absurdly low prices. Add in Oaklawn Racing & Casino, bathhouse row, and brewery scene. Nobody talks about Arkansas golf and that's what makes it great.

top_courses.name: Hot Springs Village (Balboa)
top_courses.must_know: Best of the 9 HSV courses. Edmund Ault design through mountain forest. Elevation changes, creek crossings, stunning Ozark views. $30-60 for this quality is criminal.

top_courses.name: Hot Springs Village (Isabella)
top_courses.must_know: Gene Bates design. Most playable of the HSV courses. Beautiful lake and mountain views.

top_courses.name: Alotian Club
top_courses.must_know: Tom Fazio design. One of the most exclusive clubs in the South. Hosted Walker Cup. If you can get an invite, take it. Otherwise, dream.

top_courses.name: Stonebridge Meadows (Fayetteville)
top_courses.must_know: In NW Arkansas. Good value public course. Well-maintained.

hidden_gems.name: Big Creek Golf & Country Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Mountain Home area. Beautiful Ozark setting. Incredible value.

hidden_gems.name: Mystic Creek Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: El Dorado. Newer Davis Love III design. Under the radar.

lodging_options.name: Hot Springs Village rentals/lodges
lodging_options.note: Vacation homes inside the Village. Walk to courses. Full kitchens.

lodging_options.name: Hotel & Spa at Hot Springs
lodging_options.note: Downtown Hot Springs on Bathhouse Row. Thermal baths, spa.

lodging_options.name: Hampton Inn Hot Springs
lodging_options.note: Clean, central, affordable. Typical chain quality.

dining.name: McClard's Bar-B-Q
dining.must_know: Bill Clinton's favorite BBQ joint. Since 1928. Ribs and tamales. A must.

dining.name: Superior Bathhouse Brewery
dining.must_know: Only brewery in a national park. Brewed with Hot Springs thermal water. Unique.

dining.name: Rolando's Restaurante
dining.must_know: Best Latin food in Hot Springs. James Beard nominated.

insider_tips: Hot Springs Village visitor passes give access to all 9 courses. Play 3-4 in a trip at $30-60 each. Insane value.
Oaklawn Casino has thoroughbred racing Jan-May. If timing works, it's a blast.
McClard's BBQ is cash only and closes early. Plan accordingly.
The thermal baths on Bathhouse Row are legit therapeutic. Perfect recovery day between rounds.
Northwest Arkansas (Fayetteville/Bentonville) is a separate trip worth making — Crystal Bridges museum + great golf.
Everything in Arkansas is cheap. Dinner for 8 at a nice restaurant runs $200-300 total.

activities: Arrive LIT, drive to Hot Springs (60 min)

destinations.avoid_reason: North Carolina summer heat and humidity.
destinations.why_go: The Golf Capital of the World — and it earns the title. Pinehurst No. 2 is hosting the 2024 US Open (men's and women's). 40+ courses in a 15-mile radius. Stay at the resort and play 3-4 different Pinehurst courses, then supplement with the outstanding public and semi-private options around Southern Pines.

top_courses.name: Pinehurst No. 2
top_courses.must_know: The cathedral of American golf. Host of multiple US Opens. Donald Ross's masterpiece, restored by Coore/Crenshaw in 2011 with native sand areas and wire grass. Caddie strongly recommended ($60+tip). Must stay at resort to play.

top_courses.name: Pinehurst No. 4
top_courses.must_know: Gil Hanse redesign (2018). Many consider it the best playing experience at Pinehurst now. Wide fairways, strategic bunkering, incredible greens. Host of 2019 US Amateur.

top_courses.name: Tobacco Road
top_courses.must_know: Mike Strantz's wild, divisive masterpiece. Blind shots, massive sand waste areas, love-it-or-hate-it design. 20 min from Pinehurst. Not for everyone but unforgettable.

top_courses.name: Mid Pines Inn & Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Donald Ross design restored by Kyle Franz. Sister course to Pine Needles. Classic golden-age golf. Intimate boutique resort feel.

top_courses.name: Pine Needles Lodge & Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Donald Ross design. Hosted 3 US Women's Opens. Sister to Mid Pines. Walking encouraged. Beautiful club with the Peggy Kirk Bell legacy.

hidden_gems.name: Talamore Golf Resort
hidden_gems.must_know: Rees Jones design. Great conditioning for the price. Llama caddies used to be a thing.

hidden_gems.name: Dormie Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Coore/Crenshaw design. Walking only. Members club but limited public play. If you can get on, do it.

lodging_options.name: Pinehurst Resort (Carolina Hotel)
lodging_options.note: The grand hotel. Walking distance to No. 2. Full resort with 9 courses, spa, restaurants.

lodging_options.name: Mid Pines Inn
lodging_options.note: Intimate 1921 Donald Ross era inn. On-site course. Old-school charm.

lodging_options.name: Pine Needles Lodge
lodging_options.note: Lodge with on-site Ross course. Golf packages. Great value for the quality.

lodging_options.name: Hampton Inn Southern Pines
lodging_options.note: Standard chain 10 min from Pinehurst. Saves money for green fees.

dining.name: The Carolina Dining Room
dining.must_know: At Pinehurst Resort. Fine dining. The traditional post-round dinner spot since 1901.

dining.name: The Deuce at Pinehurst
dining.must_know: Casual pub at the resort. Named after No. 2. Good post-round spot.

dining.name: Dugan's Pub
dining.must_know: Downtown Southern Pines. Sports bar with character. Locals' favorite.

insider_tips: No. 2 gets all the press, but No. 4 (Gil Hanse) might be the more enjoyable round. Play both.
Tobacco Road is either the best or worst round of your life. There is no middle ground. Play it.
Book a Pinehurst resort package for 3+ rounds — the per-round price drops significantly.
Walking is strongly encouraged at Pinehurst. Get a caddie for No. 2 — they know the green contours you can't see.
Mid Pines is the hidden star. Recently restored to pristine Donald Ross condition at half the price of No. 2.
Spring and fall are perfect. Summer is doable but hot. Winter has the best rates.

destinations.avoid_reason: Pennsylvania winter. Cold, many courses close.
destinations.why_go: Saucon Valley is a top-100 course that hosted the Senior Players Championship. Lehigh Valley has excellent public golf, a growing craft beer scene, and SteelStacks entertainment. Within driving distance of NYC, Philly, and NJ. The underrated Mid-Atlantic golf weekend.

top_courses.name: Saucon Valley CC (Old Course)
top_courses.must_know: Hosted US Senior Open, Senior Players Championship. Private but resort guests get access through Saucon Valley packages. Three courses on property — Old Course is the championship test.

top_courses.name: Steel Club
top_courses.must_know: Former Bethlehem Steel executive course. Good conditioning, interesting history. Solid value.

top_courses.name: Bethlehem Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: Municipal course with hilly terrain. Walking-friendly. Great value for the quality.

top_courses.name: Olde Homestead Golf Club
top_courses.must_know: 18 min from Bethlehem in New Tripoli. Rolling farmland setting. Challenging and scenic.

hidden_gems.name: Whitetail Golf Club
hidden_gems.must_know: In Bath. Mountain views. Well-maintained. Under the radar.

hidden_gems.name: Woodstone Country Club
hidden_gems.must_know: Near Danielsville. Public access to a private-feel course.

lodging_options.name: Hotel & Casino at Wind Creek Bethlehem
lodging_options.note: Casino resort on former Bethlehem Steel site. Restaurants, entertainment. Great group base.

lodging_options.name: Sayre Mansion B&B
lodging_options.note: Historic mansion in downtown Bethlehem. Upscale B&B experience.

lodging_options.name: Homewood Suites / Courtyard
lodging_options.note: Standard chains. Central Lehigh Valley location.

dining.name: Apollo Grill
dining.must_know: Best restaurant in Bethlehem. Mediterranean-inspired. Great bar.

dining.name: The Bayou
dining.must_know: Cajun/Creole in Bethlehem. Fun vibe, solid food, strong drinks.

dining.name: Bonn Place Brewing
dining.must_know: Craft brewery in a converted funeral home. Unique atmosphere. Great beer.

insider_tips: Saucon Valley Old Course is worth the premium. Book through a resort package for best access.
SteelStacks is a converted Bethlehem Steel plant — now an arts/entertainment district. Cool evening activity.
Lehigh Valley is 75 min from NYC, 60 min from Philly. Easy driving distance for weekend trips.
Wind Creek Casino makes this a mini-Atlantic City without the seedy boardwalk.
Fall foliage (Oct) in the Lehigh Valley is beautiful. Book for peak color.

activities: Arrive ABE, check into Wind Creek
